proposals.description: Incomplete fact extraction in turn d5ec4da3-06a5-452b-9247-e8e3ec517a61 with only 2490ch extracted from 176ch user input
proposals.rationale: This indicates a severe data loss issue where only a fraction of user input is being processed, potentially causing critical information to be missed in downstream analysis
proposals.proposed_action: Investigate the extract completeness logic in de_mod_pipeline.py to ensure full user input is captured and processed

proposals.description: MCP intent classification failing to properly classify 'report' intent in multiple turns with incorrect extracted values
proposals.rationale: The intent classification system is producing inconsistent results that could lead to incorrect routing or processing of user requests
proposals.proposed_action: Review the MCP intent classification logic to ensure proper handling of 'report' intent classification and correct value extraction

proposals.description: Entity correctness issues in turn d5ec4da3-06a5-452b-9247-e8e3ec517a61 with code extraction from de_mod_pipeline.py
proposals.rationale: The entity extraction is not properly identifying or classifying entities, which could lead to incorrect data processing and analysis
proposals.proposed_action: Examine the entity extraction logic in de_mod_pipeline.py to improve entity correctness and ensure proper identification of relevant entities

proposals.description: Incomplete extract coverage for short turns with minimal user input like '1+1 답만 해줘'
proposals.rationale: Short turns with minimal input are not being adequately covered, which could indicate issues with the extraction system's ability to handle concise queries
proposals.proposed_action: Analyze the extract coverage logic for short turns to ensure all user input is properly captured and processed

proposals.description: Inconsistent MCP tag assignment with greeting and welcome tags in turn 4fa75004-1e15-427d-913b-057a6967ed04
proposals.rationale: The tag assignment appears to be overly broad or inconsistent, potentially affecting downstream processing or analytics
proposals.proposed_action: Review the MCP tag extraction logic to ensure proper and consistent tag assignment based on actual conversation context

proposals.description: Operational metrics (timing, tokens) are not recorded in review_facts
proposals.rationale: Missing operational metrics prevents performance monitoring and optimization of the extraction pipeline
proposals.proposed_action: Update review_facts function in extract_pipeline.py to capture and log timing and token usage from LLM responses

proposals.description: Activity log body lacks faithfulness scores, retry history, and unfaithful fact lists
proposals.rationale: Incomplete activity log prevents proper tracking of extraction quality and troubleshooting of failures
proposals.proposed_action: Modify activity_log construction to include faithfulness scores, retry counts, and lists of unfaithful facts from review_facts

proposals.description: review_facts.verdict remains 'pending' and is never updated in downstream pipeline
proposals.rationale: This prevents proper state management and downstream processing of extraction results
proposals.proposed_action: Implement UPDATE logic in downstream pipeline to set review_facts.verdict to appropriate values (e.g., 'pass', 'fail', 'retry')

proposals.description: LLM client does not extract token usage and timing from API responses
proposals.rationale: Missing token usage data prevents cost monitoring and performance optimization of LLM calls
proposals.proposed_action: Update lib/llm_client.py to parse and extract token usage and timing information from /v1/completions API responses

proposals.description: enqueue_review() 함수将 queue_status 始终设置为 'reviewed'，绕过 P-R-J 流程
proposals.rationale: 这会导致审核流程被跳过，系统无法正确跟踪审核状态，造成数据不一致和流程违规
proposals.proposed_action: 修改 queue_writer.py 中的 enqueue_review() 函数，根据实际审核状态动态设置 queue_status，而不是始终设置为 'reviewed'

proposals.description: fact_index 在 extract_pipeline.py 中不一致，导致 Qwen30B 模型的 mcp_meta 被存储为单独的行
proposals.rationale: 数据索引不一致可能导致模型元数据丢失或错误关联，影响模型管理和数据完整性
proposals.proposed_action: 审查并统一 extract_pipeline.py 中的 fact_index 处理逻辑，确保所有模型（包括 Qwen30B）使用一致的索引机制

proposals.description: extract_pipeline.py 中的 MCP 实体文件路径验证未使用绝对路径转换，存在路径遍历风险
proposals.rationale: 直接使用 os.path.join() 而不进行路径规范化可能导致目录遍历攻击，允许访问受限文件
proposals.proposed_action: 在 extract_pipeline.py 的路径处理逻辑中添加 os.path.abspath() 或 os.path.realpath() 来规范化路径

proposals.description: review_consumer.py 中的 27B verify 函数未收集 timing/token 信息
proposals.rationale: 缺少性能监控数据会影响系统优化和资源分配决策，降低系统可观测性
proposals.proposed_action: 修改 review_consumer.py 中的 call_verify_model() 函数，添加对 timing 和 token 使用情况的收集和记录
